three_lane_lock.quote_for_parent: Agreed (w-mem ⊕ w-clock ⊕ w-scaler): 33.1776 MB/s per full-frame direction @24 I420 1280×720 (1.65888 B/clk_sys avg). Steady R+W 66.3552 MB/s. PPC=2 does not multiply frame DDR bytes. 3.0 B/clk is linebuf DE consume, not DDR.
